hero.title: Put your team's experience to work where it matters.
hero.body: List employees as mentors, sponsor a school talk, or fund a term of talks outright. It's a direct, low-effort way to meet your CSR goals — and it's felt by an actual student, not just a report.

cta.title: Want to talk it through?
cta.body: Tell us roughly what you have in mind — a handful of mentors, a sponsored talk, or ongoing support — and we'll work out what fits.
